reason: A DSH web plugin that adds a responsive right-side timeline for previewing and jumping between user messages in a conversation.

summaries.zh: 为 DSH 网页聊天界面添加可悬停预览并跳转到用户消息的响应式右侧对话时间线导航栏。
summaries.en: Adds a responsive right-side conversation timeline to the DSH web chat interface for previewing and jumping to user messages.

capabilities: Renders a right-side conversation navigation rail
Reads user-message entries and previews from the current conversation
Loads older conversation messages when navigating
Adapts the panel to themes, viewport size, and adjacent workspace panels
